source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Sapindus saponaria L. var. drummondii (Hook. & Arn.) L.D. Benson; bracketed Sapindus drummondii Hook. & Arn.

morphology_documented.leaves: Generally even-pinnate, sometimes odd; (10–)18–19 sickle-lanceolate leaflets, glabrous to soft-pubescent below
morphology_documented.fruit: Amber-yellow translucent globe around single seed, about 13 mm wide; seed 8–9 mm
morphology_documented.habitat: Stream bottoms, wooded edges and disturbed areas

source_scope_note: Historic taxonomic rank maintained; comparative key traits or family-only descriptions not automatically promoted to accepted species level.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 flora names historical variety of S. saponaria and explicitly brackets accepted inventory binomial; preserve original rank
Fruit saponins described but do not infer edible utility
preservation: Additive species source references only; no original records, photos, credits or galleries changed
